get.summary: Search the audit ledger of the caller tenant
get.description: Requires audit:read (auditor, org_admin). Newest first, by (occurredAt, seq). The tenant comes from the caller, never from the query. `from` and `to` are ISO-8601 UTC with a Z. Pass the previous nextCursor to continue; a cursor is bound to its filters. The query itself is recorded as audit.queried. includeChain=true needs the auditor role.

get.summary: Stream the live events of one run (text/event-stream)
get.description: Requires run:read in the caller tenant. A run outside that tenant answers 403 exactly like a missing one. Each run event is one frame: `id` is the stream entry id, `event` the run event type, `data` the JSON event. Reconnect with the `Last-Event-ID` header (or `lastEventId` query) to replay the missed events; at most API_SSE_MAX_REPLAY are replayed. Control frames (no id): `state` and `end` for a finished run or a terminal event, `resync` (refetch the run: events were trimmed, the client was too slow, or the replay was too long), `timeout` (API_SSE_MAX_DURATION_MS reached) and `error` (the event source failed; reconnect with backoff). The `event` names `state`, `resync`, `end`, `timeout` and `error` are reserved for control frames. A heartbeat comment (`: heartbeat`) is sent every API_SSE_HEARTBEAT_MS while idle.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Stream id of the last event received; resumes after it.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description: Same as the Last-Event-ID header, for clients that cannot set headers.

put.summary: Replace the tenant override of a persona
put.description: Requires settings:write (org_admin). The body replaces the whole override; an empty object resets the persona to its base values. Only effort, maxTurns, maxBudgetUsd and lowerStandardTier are accepted: any other field answers OVERRIDE_FIELD_FORBIDDEN. Values above the persona bounds are clamped, never raised. The change is audited as persona.override_changed.
